name: facebookresearch_dcd/algos/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_dcd/algos/agent.py.create_acagent_instance: create an ACAgent instance by passing an algo and storage object to the constructor
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/agent.py.update_acagent: update the ACAgent by calling update with optional discard_grad and kl_dict parameters
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/agent.py.act_with_acagent: act using the ACAgent by calling act with observation and recurrent hidden state arguments
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/agent.py.get_value_from_acagent: get the value estimate from the ACAgent by calling get_value with the current observation
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/agent.py.move_acagent_to_device: move the ACAgent and its storage to a target device like cuda by calling to

facebookresearch_dcd/algos/ppo.py.create_PPO_agent: create a PPO reinforcement learning agent with an actor-critic network and Adam optimizer
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/ppo.py.update_PPO_policy: update the PPO policy using rollout data with clipped surrogate objective and value loss
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/ppo.py.compute_PPO_grad_norm: compute the L2 gradient norm across all actor-critic parameters for monitoring training stability
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/ppo.py.review_PPO_update: review the PPO update method to understand clipped surrogate loss and advantage normalization logic
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/ppo.py.refactor_PPO_kl_loss: refactor the PPO update method to add or modify KL divergence loss between protagonist and antagonist distributions

facebookresearch_dcd/algos/storage.py.create_RolloutStorage: create a RolloutStorage buffer to store observations, actions, rewards, and value predictions for PPO training
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/storage.py.insert_rollout_data: insert a timestep of observations, actions, rewards, and masks into the RolloutStorage buffer
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/storage.py.compute_returns: compute GAE or discounted returns for all timesteps in the RolloutStorage buffer using gamma and lambda
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/storage.py.generate_feed_forward_batches: generate mini-batches from the RolloutStorage buffer for feed-forward PPO policy updates
facebookresearch_dcd/algos/storage.py.generate_recurrent_batches: generate mini-batches from the RolloutStorage buffer for recurrent PPO policy updates with hidden states
